content.rendered:
Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Install electrical service equipment, wiring, and devices required for the installation of residential solar systems.
  • Install projects as contracted and designed.
  • Obtain all required materials to complete assigned project.
  • Proper installation of required materials.
  • All electrical work meets or exceeds current National Electrical Code as well as local jurisdiction requirements.
  • Oversee and effectively communicate with local inspectors.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Must be a motivated team player, looking to succeed.
  • 1+ years of experience as a Solar or Residential Electrician preferred.
  • Ability to calculate total load amperage ratings, wattages, KW & KVA sizes.
  • Ability to perform physical requirements of the project.
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints and drawings.
  • Professional appearance and demeanor, with excellent communication skills.
  • Must be a motivated team player, looking to succeed.
  • Strong work ethic and grit.
  • Must submit and pass a background check.

Solar APPRENTICE Requirements:

  • Professional appearance and a friendly disposition
  • Ability to travel out of town
  • Patience; self-motivated and outgoing
  • Ability to relate technical information in layman’s terms
  • Ability to pass a drug and background check
